name: fedclient-desktop
description: Electron shell for FedClient (FastAPI + Vite React)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:backend: cd ../backend && sh -c 'if [ -x venv/bin/python ]; then exec venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9090; else exec python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9090; fi'
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on -t 120000 http://127.0.0.1:9090/docs http://127.0.0.1:5174 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ELECTRON_SKIP_BACKEND=1 ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 electron .
scripts.start:packaged: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build:frontend && electron .
